name: MixEval
description: A meta-benchmark that strategically mixes questions from existing benchmarks to approximate real-world user preferences at ~1,000x lower cost than Chatbot Arena. Achieves 0.96 correlation with Chatbot Arena Elo ratings. MixEval-Hard is provided for frontier model differentiation. The approach derives ensemble 'wisdom of the crowd' from multiple benchmark sources rather than creating new questions.
evaluation_method: accuracy; composite score correlated with Chatbot Arena Elo
reputation: Published at NeurIPS 2024; widely adopted as cost-effective Chatbot Arena alternative; maintained active leaderboard; 0.96 correlation with human preference ratings
notes: Published at NeurIPS 2024. Achieves 0.96 Spearman correlation with Chatbot Arena Elo at approximately 1,000x lower evaluation cost. MixEval-Hard targets frontier model differentiation where standard MixEval saturates. The benchmark strategically combines questions from multiple benchmarks weighted by real-world user query distributions. Active leaderboard maintained by the authors.
